EmailTemplate.subject: Keep up the Great Work!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {{{Recipient.FirstName}}},
Congratulations on reaching the midpoint of your training.
Over the past two weeks, you've been building essential skills in scent mechanics, canine health, and detection fundamentals. This phase of the program lays the foundation for successful certification.
As you continue training: - Stay focused on daily training - Reach out if you need support - Continue preparing for certification requirments.
We're proud of the work you've put in so far and look forward to seeing your continued progress.
Keep up the great work!
Best regards,
The AK9I Team
